name: melee_ally_in_the_way
about: A melee NPC whose way to the enemy is blocked by an ally circles instead of advancing through it. Two bat-only TutorialThug humans (npc_VHumanCombatant, item_w_baseball_bat, D_HT 5 to the player, no relationship to each other: neutral) stand in one line with the player: arena_front 200 cm in front of the player, arena_rear 250 cm behind arena_front, both facing the player. CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleMeleeCombat 0x10385e40 (slot 604; bat-only, so the _NR forms: slot 308 HasUsableRangedWeapon 0x10336d70 is false) asks 0x102a11d0 before it advances: a swept slab (the hull's mins/maxs doubled in X/Y, Z +-6, mask 0x2000000) from WorldSpaceCenter to the enemy, true when the nearest body met is an NPC this one does not hate (IRelationType != D_HT). With arena_front between, arena_rear's answer is the circle pair, 0xe1 SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_CIRCLE_ADVANCE_NR, never 0xcb SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ADVANCE_NR (stories/v4/packets-S2.md, 0x102a11d0; packets-S3.md item 8; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J10).
known_red: V11 (N3: no NPC enters melee), then V11-1 (J10): ScheduleMeleeReachGate is a seam answering false
notes: The schedules are matched by their class-local number (0xe1, 0xcb), not by name: if the trace prints another name for either, the number still decides (brief A0 item 7). The `never` on 0xcb closes at 8 s: arena_front is 200 cm (79 units) from the player and advances to swing, after which it no longer stands between and a plain advance by arena_rear is retail.
